pretraining_graph.feature_provenance: ACM: fixed supplied paper-word attributes, row-normalized independently per retained node. Shared feature-column semantics are fixed input; upstream construction of the supplied paper vocabulary is not newly inferred from source-only data.
pretraining_graph.positive_policy: Sum symmetrically normalized graph-local binary metapath adjacency; rank off-diagonal neighbors, at most 8; include self; all variants use the identical fixed positives.
pretraining_graph.projection_validation: Every sampled row verified by independent raw-relation path traversal, without released metapath/positive matrices.

training.learning_rate_selection: Original fixed base rate; no source/target label tuning and no full-graph selected rates
training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum pre-update training SSL loss, never target labels

label_use: Only downstream 20-per-class train / 10-per-class validation / remaining-node test; no encoder training or checkpoint selection
